berry_at_the_fire: Tomb of the Unknown Soldier. Cenotaph. Arc. Westminster. and all the forgotten of World War I. one body so every missing name has ground. brown DOWN into Flanders earth. we do not invent the name. we seat the silence. Unknown, and yet well-known.
